info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Gap Analysis Submission API
info.description: The Gap Analysis Submission API enables businesses to submit and manage their gap analysis reports effectively. This endpoint allows users to send detailed analyses that identify discrepancies between expected and actual performance in banking models. Typical consumers include financial analysts and risk managers who require insights into operational gaps for strategic decision-making. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their understanding of market positioning and optimize performance outcomes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new gap analysis, enabling assessment of discrepancies between current and desired states within a specified context.
